title: Assistant agentic item 12: Anthropic adapter, audited graduation, hook evaluators, richer UX
intended_behavior: Anthropic agent model provider uses /v1/messages with anthropic-version and native tool_use/tool_result blocks behind the AgentModelClient seam.
assistant.agentic.provider accepts openai_compatible and anthropic while assistant.agentic.enabled remains false by default.
assistant.permissions.mode defaults to audited; review remains selectable; audited allows reads and low/medium-risk scoped mutations while asking for high/destructive risk.
Risk is upgraded from arguments containing production/prod/rollback/delete/remove/revoke markers to high risk.
Prompt hooks evaluate via the configured agent model client and mcp-tool hooks execute only registered read-only synchronous MCP tools.
Assistant UI renders native tool calls, async downstream waits, subagent runs, and phase timeline details without breaking action approval.
out_of_scope: external MCP merge path in internal/mcp/registry.go and internal/adapters/mcpclient/
pre-existing internal/service SecurityScanner failures tracked as bahia-x3km
pre-existing web Playwright baseline tracked as bahia-e1gn
